newsitem.title: USA: U.S. says Bhutto sacking seems constitutional.
newsitem.headline: U.S. says Bhutto sacking seems constitutional.

text.p: The United States said the sacking of Pakistani prime minister Benazir Bhutto on Tuesday appeared to be constitutional.
"The dismissal of the government appears to be in accordance with the Pakistan constitution," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters.

Burns said the United States had had longstanding "good relations" with Pakistan, and expected to continue them with the interim government and whatever government was elected in polls set for February.
The United States had no advance warning from Pakistan of Bhutto's dismissal, Burns said.
Bhutto was sacked on Tuesday for a second time in her turbulent political career by the country's president, who accused her government of corruption, nepotism and misrule.
